description: This script generates and compiles an Android native test APK, managing source files, replacing placeholders, copying libraries, and building with ant.

classes.name: NativeTestApkGenerator
classes.description: A class to generate and build a native test APK for Android, handling file copying, string replacement, library copying, and compilation.

methods.name: _LibraryRoot
methods.description: Extracts the root name of the shared library for use in APK files.

methods.name: _CopyTemplateFilesAndClearDir
methods.description: Copies necessary source files to the output directory, cleaning it beforehand.

methods.name: _ReplaceStrings
methods.description: Replaces placeholder strings in files with the library root name.

methods.name: _CopyLibrary
methods.description: Copies the native shared library into the APK source tree.

methods.name: CreateBundle
methods.description: Creates the APK source bundle by copying files, replacing strings, and copying the library.

methods.name: Compile
methods.description: Builds the APK using ant with specified arguments.
